content:
A number of projects have an upstreaming dashboard (e.g. FLT), which rely on data from <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leanprover-community/queueboard/refs/heads/master/processed_data/open_pr_data.json>, which no longer exists. The script that uses the data is here: https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/FLT/blob/main/scripts/upstreaming_dashboard.py

Is there an easy replacement? @Bryan Gin-ge Chen
Yes, sorry, this was on me. The previous repo got too large for GitHub (for the second time) so I had to recreate it, and I forgot that there were other consumers of the data.

I've gone through the projects mentioned in #mathlib4 > upstreaming dashboard and started creating PRs to migrate them to the new action. Before I mark them all ready for review, is there one we can test the new action on quickly to make sure everything is working? Maybe one of @Yaël Dillies's repos (?) if they're available?

  • YaelDillies/Toric#53
  • YaelDillies/LeanCamCombi#47
  • FLT#872
  • PNT#1206

If there are other projects using the upstreaming dashboard you know of, please post them here: @Yaël Dillies @Ruben Van de Velde.
I have tested the action in https://github.com/marcelolynch/PagesPlayground, which mimics Toric (result)
Oh, I was actually doing this already with ForbiddenMatrix: https://github.com/YaelDillies/forbidden-matrix
Aha, I guess you usually want include-drafts: true for your projects?
Hmm, not sure. I never make any of my PRs draft, but it wouldn't hurt to include draft PRs anyway

Yaël Dillies said:

Oh, I was actually doing this already with ForbiddenMatrix: https://github.com/YaelDillies/forbidden-matrix

Looks like the workflow is failing here as the array arg for the action is not supported

 relevant-labels: ["forbidden-matrix"]

it should just be relevant-labels: "forbidden-matrix"
Whoops, I thought I had fixed that already. But also why say relevant-labels if you can specify only one?
You can comma or newline separate a list of tags. Actions can only take string params so it's gotta be like that
Definitely worth including an example in the README!
As Bryan rightly pointed out to me earlier :) https://github.com/leanprover-community/upstreaming-dashboard-action/pull/1
Also, you should update upstream.md to include {% include _upstreaming_dashboard/dashboard.md %}, namely adding the _upstreaming_dashboard prefix
I thought I had fixed that too... Let me check my local repo for unpushed fixes
OK, I marked the PRs to Toric and LeanCamCombi as ready to review for now. If those work successfully, then I'll mark the other ones ready too.

An update: all of the above-mentioned updating PRs have been merged.

I did a code search for repos mentioning upstreaming_dashboard.py and it looks like almost everything left is a fork of a fixed repo. I opened PRs for the last 2 I saw:

  • fpvandoorn/carleson#547
  • FredRaj3/SemicircleLaw#33
